text: どの　ポケモンが　ゆめくいを　おぼえたいん　だい…？

structure.jp: ゆめくいを　おぼえたいん　だい…？

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb stem means 'want to'. おぼえたい = 'wants to learn'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.span: おぼえたいん　だい
patterns.explanation: んだ asks for or gives an explanation; だい is a soft, friendly question form of だ used mostly by men. おぼえたいん だい = 'so which one wants to learn it?'
